messages.text: BL-1906 🎵 in progress — The dropped-parcel sweep and dispatch_trail_cli.bb count a parcel in flight only from role mailboxes, so a ticket QA queued for BL-1872's lander reads as dropped while it waits: on 2026-10-02 BL-1879 was nudged four times and re-sent to QA, and the router would route it to the coder without --force; a lander entry still queued or running now counts as in flight
